div.head: I Cn 5.2b
div.ab: And gyf man gehadodne mid fæhþe belecge ⁊ secge, þæt he wære dædbana oððe rædbana, ladige mid his magum, þe fæhðe moton mid beran oððe forebetan.
And gif man gehadodne mid fæhðe belegce ⁊ segce, þæt he wære dædbana oððe rædbana, ladige mid his magum, þæ fehþe moton mid beran oððe forebetan.
Si quis ordinatus homicidii particeps consilio uel auxilio fuisse compelletur, purget se cum parentibus suis, quorum interest occisionis factionem tolerare uel emendare.
Si quis ordinatus calumniatur de homicidio, quod fuisset in facto aut in consilio, purget se cum parentibus suis, qui possunt emendare aut deportare.

Et si ordinatus mortis cause calumpniam patitur siue facti siue consilii, et se nocentem fuisse negauerit, purget se cognatis, quibus licet mortis causam simul cum eo aut ferre aut de mortis causa pro illo satisfacere.
And gyf man gehadodne mid fæhþe belecge ⁊ secge þæt he wære dædbana oððe rædbana, ladige mid his magum þe fæhðe moton mid beran oððe forebetan.
And gyf man gehadodne mid fæhþe belecge and secge, þæt he wære dædbana oððe rædbana, ladige mid his magum, þe fæhðe moton mid beran oððe fore betan.

Und wenn ein Kleriker mit Fehde belegt und angeklagt wird, dass er thätlich Todtschläger oder durch Rath Mordstifter gewesen sei, so schwöre er sich rein mit seinen Verwandten, die Fehde mit zu tragen oder an deren Statt Busse zu zahlen haben.

And if a cleric is charged with a feud and accused of having been a slayer by deed or by counsel, let him clear himself with his kinsmen, who must share the feud with him or pay compensation in his place.

And if a man in holy orders is charged with vendetta and accused of having committed or instigated homicide, he shall clear himself with the help of his kin, who must share the vendetta with him or pay compensation for it.

And if charge of feud is brought against a member of the clergy, and he is accused of either murder or complicity in a murder, he shall exonerate himself with the help of his family, who must either share in the feud or make compensation for it.
